{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the correct column name for status
print("Column names:")
print(sales_df.columns)

# Correctly filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check the filtered data
print("\nFiltered data shape:")
print(loyal_completed.shape)

print("\nRevenue summary for loyal completed orders:")
print(loyal_completed['revenue'].describe())

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()
print(f"\nMean revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
